fileNodes.name: game.py
fileNodes.summary: Core game engine for the Pacman AI projects: defines the Agent interface, direction constants, configurations, boolean grids, the game-state data packet, and the Game control loop that solicits actions from agents and applies rules.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Uses `from util import *` star-imports, so utility helpers (TimeoutFunction, nearestPoint, raiseNotDefined) are resolved at module scope rather than through explicit imports.

fileNodes.name: keyboardAgents.py
fileNodes.summary: Provides human-controlled Pacman agents that translate keyboard input (WASD/arrow keys, or IJKL for the second player) into legal movement actions.

fileNodes.name: layout.py
fileNodes.summary: Loads and parses .lay maze files into Layout objects that expose walls, food, capsules and agent start positions, plus the lookup helpers the game and agents use to find layouts.

fileNodes.name: pacman.py
fileNodes.summary: Main entry point and rules layer for Pacman: defines the agent-facing GameState, the classic win/lose rules, pacman and ghost movement rules, and the CLI that wires layouts, agents and displays into games.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Agents are discovered dynamically at runtime by importing any *Agents.py module on PYTHONPATH and looking up the class by name, so agent files are not statically imported.

fileNodes.name: pacmanAgents.py
fileNodes.summary: Baseline Pacman agents: a left-turning agent and a greedy agent that one-step-looks-ahead over legal actions using a pluggable evaluation function.

fileNodes.name: ghostAgents.py
fileNodes.summary: Defines the ghost agent policies used during multi-agent search: an abstract GhostAgent plus uniformly random and Pacman-seeking/fleeing DirectionalGhost implementations that expose action probability distributions.

fileNodes.name: multiAgents.py
fileNodes.summary: Student implementation file for the adversarial search project, containing the reflex agent, the shared multi-agent search base class, and the Minimax, Alpha-Beta, and Expectimax agent skeletons plus evaluation functions.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Agent classes are selected at runtime by pacman.py via util.lookup, so class names must remain importable module-level symbols.

fileNodes.name: util.py
fileNodes.summary: Shared utility module providing search data structures (Stack, Queue, PriorityQueue), the Counter distribution class, probability sampling helpers, dynamic name lookup, and timeout/print-suppression helpers used across the Pacman projects.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Counter subclasses dict with a default-zero __getitem__; note sortedKeys uses the Python 2 style `cmp=` argument to sort, a legacy artifact of the course codebase.

fileNodes.name: VERSION
fileNodes.summary: One-line version stamp recording the CS188 project release number (v1.004) that this Pacman codebase corresponds to.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Plain-text single-token file with no parser support; it is read verbatim by release tooling rather than parsed as source code.

fileNodes.name: projectParams.py
fileNodes.summary: Project-wide configuration module that tells the autograder which student file to grade, which test-class module to load, the human-readable project name, and whether bonus questions are enabled.
fileNodes.languageNotes: A pure Python constants module: no imports, functions, or classes, only four uppercase module-level assignments that other modules read via attribute access.
